story: Born in Ubud, I started driving for my uncle's guests in 2014. Back then I knew three roads. Now I know which ones avoid the Saturday market traffic.
Most guests book one day and then a second. Families ask for a slower pace; couples ask for the viewpoints nobody else stops at.
I speak English and Bahasa Indonesia, and I can explain temple etiquette and the ceremony calendar on the way.
values: Three things I do on every trip.
On time, every time
I arrive 10 minutes before pickup. If traffic changes the plan, you hear it from me first.
A safe, clean car
The car is serviced every 5.000 km. I check tyres and brakes before the first trip of the day.
Honest advice
I suggest an order that avoids the crowds, and I take no commission from shops.

story: Hi, I'm Wayan. I grew up in Ubud and I've been driving guests since 2014. The short version: I know the shortcuts, the warungs worth stopping at, and when to leave.
Most people do one day with me and then ask for another, usually because the first one went smoothly and they want to see one more place.
English and Indonesian both work. Ask me anything, including what the ceremonies on the road mean.
values: How I work
Early, every time
I am there 10 minutes before pickup. If the traffic changes the plan, I message you before you have to ask.
A car I trust
Serviced every 5.000 km. Tyres and brakes checked before the first trip of the day.
No detours for commission
I pick the order that avoids the crowds. I do not get paid to stop at shops.

story: I was raised in Ubud and have been driving visitors around this island since 2014. Every trip starts with a conversation: what you love, how tired you are, how much time you have.
Families tell me the best part is the slow pace. Couples tell me it is the quiet viewpoints. I just try to make the day feel like yours.
I speak English and Bahasa Indonesia. Along the way I will explain what the offerings on the dashboard are for, and why we take our time at temples.
values: What you can count on from me.
I am early
Ten minutes before pickup, every time. If the road changes the plan, you hear it from me first.
The car is clean and safe
Serviced every 5.000 km, with tyres and brakes checked before the first trip of the day.
I tell you the truth
I suggest the order that avoids the crowds, and I take no commission from shops or restaurants.

story: Ubud is where I was born, and where I have chauffeured guests since 2014. The car is kept immaculate, the route is planned quietly, and the day unfolds without rush.
Honeymoon couples, families and business travellers ask for different things. What they share is the wish for a day that feels effortless.
English and Bahasa Indonesia, with discretion. I can explain temple customs and the ceremony calendar whenever you wish to hear them.
values: Standards
Punctual, discreet
I arrive ten minutes early and wait without fuss. Schedule changes reach you directly, never through a third party.
Immaculate vehicle
Serviced every 5.000 km and inspected before the first departure of each day.
Honest counsel
The route is shaped around your pace. No commissions, no detours to shops.
